newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank postpones board meeting to Oct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank postpones board meeting to Oct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Tuesday it would postpone a boarding meeting scheduled for Thursday until October.
"The board meeting will be held some time in October," central bank deputy governor Liang Cheng-ching told journalists.
Liang did not give a specific date for the meeting.
Earlier on Tuesday the central bank had said in a statement that it was postponing the board meeting because many board members could not attend the meeting.
The bank had said it would review a proposal at the board meeting to set a direction to lower banks' reserve requirements and at the same time raise the liquidity ratio.
"The central bank will continue to take action to adjust the financial condition based on economic and financial situation at home and abroad," the bank statement said.
